spec: npx cold-start: cron-parser dep-drift fix + guard; detached boot writes server-manual.log; hard-stop on missing prerequisites (--webui-only opt-out)

behaviors.behavior: cron-parser is declared in the published package so a fresh npx install resolves it (the ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash)
behaviors.evidence: bootstrapper/test/dep-drift.test.mjs 'cron-parser specifically is declared' + subset test — PASSED; empirically probed the exact import resolves in the package node_modules layout

behaviors.behavior: dep-drift guard keeps the mirror total: every server runtime dep present with identical range; no optional/peer deps missed; overrides parity
behaviors.evidence: bootstrapper/test/dep-drift.test.mjs 5 cases (subset, range-parity, cron-parser sentinel, no optional/peer, overrides parity) — PASSED

behaviors.behavior: the detached server boot routes stdout+stderr to bootLogPath(); degrades to 'ignore' only when the log cannot open (never blocks boot)
behaviors.evidence: bootstrapper/test/server.test.mjs 'resolveBootStdio routes stdout+stderr to the log fd' + 'degrades to ignore' + bootLogPath path — PASSED

behaviors.behavior: the boot readiness-timeout error names bootLogPath() — the same log the boot actually writes (single source of truth)
behaviors.evidence: bootstrapper/test/server.test.mjs 'the boot readiness-timeout error names bootLogPath()' — PASSED

behaviors.behavior: serverBootDecision: prereqs-missing => no boot; plugins-only => no boot; webui-only or prereqs-present => boot
main() hard-stop wiring: ensureServer NEVER called + non-zero exit + install guidance when prereqs missing; boots under --webui-only; boots normally when prereqs present
behaviors.evidence: bootstrapper/test/bin.test.mjs main() wiring (3 cases, injected pluginPhase/ensureServer seams) — PASSED

behaviors.behavior: manifest and lockfile stay in sync so CI `npm ci` in bootstrapper-checks succeeds (the doubt-review HIGH)
behaviors.evidence: regenerated bootstrapper/package-lock.json with cron-parser; `npm ci --dry-run` reports in-sync (empirical); the CI npm ci step is the standing enforcement
